title.id: Peluncuran Halaman Publik Responsif dan Simulator Ancaman Berbasis Neobrutalisme
title.en: Launch of Responsive Public Landing Page and Real-time Threat Simulator with Neobrutalism Design

body.id: Menghadirkan halaman beranda publik yang sepenuhnya responsif di rute utama konsol Pasax Cloud. Mengadopsi pedoman desain Neobrutalisme modern dengan kontras tinggi, navigasi taktil, cuplikan terminal instalasi satu-perintah, demonstrasi pencegahan serangan kernel secara interaktif, komparasi matriks dengan SIEM konvensional, dan panduan FAQ teknis.
body.en: Introduced a fully responsive public landing page on the primary root route of Pasax Cloud console. Adopts modern Neobrutalism design principles with high contrast, tactile navigation, one-line install terminal snippets, interactive live kernel threat interception simulator, comparative matrix against legacy SIEMs, and technical FAQ guides.

items.id: Halaman Publik Responsif Penuh: Tampilan beranda berdaya estetika Neobrutalisme dengan navigasi taktil cerdas, pengalih mode gelap/terang, laci navigasi seluler, dan kartu sorotan metrik performa tinggi.
items.en: Fully Responsive Public Page: High-aesthetic Neobrutalism landing experience with smart tactile navigation, dark/light mode toggle, mobile navigation drawer, and high-performance metric highlight cards.

items.id: Simulator Ancaman Interaktif Langsung: Demonstrasi langsung kemampuan Sentinel mengisolasi serangan pada level kernel (nftables) dan memulihkan hak akses berkas (.env) dalam hitungan milidetik dengan tombol simulasi serangan.
items.en: Interactive Threat Interception Simulator: Live interactive component demonstrating Sentinel's capability to drop attacks in kernel space (nftables) and auto-heal compromised files within milliseconds upon clicking attack simulation.

items.id: Matriks Komparasi dan Tiga Lapis Pertahanan: Perbandingan mendalam antara Ekosistem Pasax, SIEM Tradisional (Wazuh/Datadog), Cloudflare WAF, dan Fail2ban dalam hal latensi kernel, konsumsi memori (<20MB), serta ketiadaan port terbuka.
items.en: Comparative Benchmark & Triple Defense Breakdown: In-depth architectural comparison between Pasax Suite, Traditional SIEMs, Cloudflare WAF, and Fail2ban covering kernel latency, low memory footprint (<20MB), and zero open inbound ports.

items.id: Komponen Terminal dan FAQ Akordeon: Terminal instalasi cepat satu-perintah untuk curl, Docker, dan Go CLI serta akordeon tanya jawab teknis berbasis pustaka Base UI.
items.en: One-Line Terminal & FAQ Accordion: One-line quickstart command terminal with copy feedback for curl, Docker, and Go CLI alongside technical FAQ accordions powered by Base UI.
